topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations, adaptive beamforming with beam steering and shaping is necessary. Utilizing IEEE 802.11ay standards, beam management strategies can be optimized for the 57-66 GHz band, ensuring <3 dB gain variance.
reference_context: Beamforming optimization is crucial for spectrum sharing and efficiency in high-frequency bands, with studies focusing on 17.3-20.2 GHz and 27.5-30 GHz bands.
